description: This file defines an interface for a cache that stores values with an expiration mechanism, supporting operations to insert and retrieve values with explicit expiration parameters.

classes.name: ExpiringValueCache
classes.description: A generic interface for a cache supporting expiration of stored values, parameterized by key and value types.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an expiration time specified as an Instant.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with a maximum age specified as a Duration from now.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the cache if it exists and is not expired; otherwise returns null.
